answer.says: Shri Hegde, you are up early. I trust the sleep was restful? I have my papers here; the air is thick, so I shall keep the shutters half-closed. I am to reflect on the file of your allotment this morning. I hope the second bedroom is to your liking, pending the orders from the Directorate.
answer.thought: The confusion of our names is still a living knot in the fabric of this house. He is the man to whom the state assigned these walls, and I am the ghost who woke in them. I must be courteous and clear, for the friction of our coexistence must be managed before it becomes a contradiction that tears the household apart.
